statements.impact_statement: The advisory covers golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, which no golusoris build contains: osv matches the whole golang.org/x/crypto module, no Go file in the repository imports golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, and govulncheck v1.9.0 in symbol mode on all 31 modules reports GO-2026-5932 at module level only (required, no package imported, no symbol called) in the 14 modules that require golang.org/x/crypto.
